title: VideoStoryboard
description: v2.1 contract between storyboard authoring and the deterministic render pipeline. Visual V3 adds optional immutable art-direction references while preserving legacy v2 storyboards.

schema_version.description: Semver of this contract. Renderers refuse storyboards from a different major version.

ref.description: Repo-relative path or URL of the source content this storyboard was derived from.

content_hash.description: sha256 of the source content at transformation time — provenance + staleness detection.

id.description: Channel config id, e.g. 'combat-science' (resolves to configs/channels/<id>.json).

series.description: Series lane within the channel, e.g. 'physics-of-grappling'. Drives thumbnail badge color + playlist.

voice_id.description: Provider voice id, or take label for human_recorded.

is_custom_voice.description: Must be true for elevenlabs in published runs — stock Default voices are a mass-production audio fingerprint AND are retired by ElevenLabs on 2026-12-31 (see 02-CONTENT-STRATEGY voice policy).

settings.description: Provider tuning (stability/similarity/style etc.). Passed through verbatim; part of the TTS cache key.

track_id.description: Licensed/library track id; null = no music bed.

visual_change_max_s.description: Max seconds without any on-screen change (micro-beat budget).

pattern_interrupt_max_s.description: Max seconds between deliberate pattern interrupts (gag, scene shift, diagram flip).

shorts_visual_change_max_s.description: Tighter micro-beat budget applied to vertical renders — shorts stagnate faster than landscape.

targets.description: Aspect layouts this storyboard supports. Vertical is a layout, never a crop.

expert.description: Required by the guard whenever narration uses credential framing ('a physical therapist explains…'). Never fabricated.

claims.description: Claims ledger. Every number, superlative, medical, financial, or historical assertion in narration must reference an entry here via scene.claim_refs. Empty array is valid for claim-free scripts; the guard verifies the absence.

source.description: URL or repo-relative fact-layer reference. 'corpus' allowed for transcript-derived technique steps.

shorts.description: Vertical clip plans. Each is a scene-subset with its own hook — not a center-cut of the landscape master.

hook_line.description: Replacement first-line narration/caption for the vertical cut.

titles.description: Title variants — packaging is decided at Gate A, not after render.

concept.description: One-line visual concept for the programmatic thumbnail scene.

badge_color.description: Series badge border color; defaults from channel config.

description_md.description: Video description. May contain {ARTICLE_URL} and {REGISTRY_URL} placeholders — packaging service injects UTM-tagged links.

chapters_from_scenes.description: Emit YouTube chapter markers from act/scene boundaries at packaging time.

line.description: Spoken/on-screen CTA, e.g. 'Trace your academy's lineage at NationalBJJRegistry.com'.

utm_campaign.description: Defaults to job slug; ensures every click is attributable.

required.description: YouTube's disclosure is triggered by realistic depictions of real people/events/scenes or by cloning a voice other than your own — NOT by synthetic narration over clearly non-realistic animation. Fully-animated stick-figure content with an own-voice clone → false. Guard forces true when any scene sets realistic_recreation.

act.description: Conflict-loop arc role. Guard enforces: exactly one hook (first), ≥1 develop, ≥1 conflict in the first third for runs >90s (a misconception, obstacle, or reversal found in the source), comeback paired with conflict, ≥1 payoff, exactly one cta (last).

narration_text.description: What the voice says in this scene. ~140 WPM ⇒ keep scenes under ~90 words.

manim_class.description: Scene class name; guard verifies it exists in the scenes/ registry and matches visual_type.

parameters.description: Scene-class-specific inputs: pose sequence ids, lever/force labels, map nodes+edges, chart series, etc. Validated per-class by the guard.

beats.description: Optional visual triggers anchored to narration words — the '[VISUAL: samurai gets thrown]' markers from script transformation, resolved to word indices after TTS.

at_word.description: Index into this scene's word-timing array.

action.description: Named animation the scene class exposes, e.g. 'pose:armbar_extension', 'flash_label:fulcrum'.

layout_hints.description: Per-aspect composition hints (zones, scale, caption placement). Scene classes own the defaults.

target_s.description: Authoring-time estimate from word count ÷ WPM. The measured clock arrives from audio artifacts, never stored here.

padding_s.description: Silence appended after narration before the next scene.

claim_refs.description: Ids from the claims ledger used by this scene's narration. Guard cross-checks both directions.

realistic_recreation.description: True when the scene realistically re-creates a real event/person/place (rare in this format). Any true value forces packaging.synthetic_content_disclosure.required = true.

in.description: How this scene enters. 'continuous' joins the previous scene in one rendered Manim sequence when classes are compatible — no cut at all. hard_cut is the exception and needs a reason; random-cut prevention is a design goal.

motif.description: Element carried across the boundary (e.g. 'lever_arrow', 'cast:uke') for match cuts and continuity.
